parts.name: Leg (Left Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of lightweight plastic, typically around 13 cm long and 0.5 cm thick.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the glasses on the user's ear and helps maintain stability on the head.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge connected to the base body to fold or unfold the glasses.

parts.name: Leg (Right Temple Arm)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right leg (temple arm) of the eyeglasses, made of plastic, similar in size and shape to the left leg.
parts.Functional_description: It provides balance and support on the opposite side of the head, ensuring the glasses stay in place.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate around the hinge connected to the base body to fold or unfold the glasses.

parts.name: Base Body (Frame and Lens Assembly)
parts.Basic_description: This is the main frame of the eyeglasses, holding the lenses and connecting both legs. It is made of durable plastic and typically measures about 14 cm wide and 4 cm tall.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the lenses in place and provides the structural foundation for the eyeglasses.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the legs rotate around its hinges.
